videos.title: WWDC22: Explore navigation design for iOS | Apple
videos.why: Apple's guide to familiar navigation structures such as tab bars and modal views, with best practices and the common pitfalls of each.

videos.title: User Flow Diagram Basics
videos.why: How to sketch the path someone takes through your app as a simple diagram before you design any screens.

podcasts.why: The person behind UserOnboard, known for teardowns of popular apps' first-run experiences, on what makes the first flow through a product work.

reads.title: Basic Patterns for Mobile Navigation
reads.why: The main mobile navigation patterns side by side (tab bars, hamburger menus, navigation hubs and more) with the trade-offs of each.

reads.title: Tab bars
reads.why: Apple's best practices for the most common iPhone navigation pattern, including what belongs in a tab and what does not.

reads.title: Mobile-App Onboarding: An Analysis of Components and Techniques
reads.why: Breaks onboarding into its three usual parts (feature promotion, customisation and instructions) and argues for skipping it whenever possible.
